candidates.name: pair_atlas_schema
candidates.summary: Per-pair, per-move compatibility scores as an evidence layer above the selector (from the STAR survey top-5, 2026-10-26).

candidates.name: merge_hold_handover
candidates.summary: Named compound base: merge, hold, hand over, with hold length from measured stem energy and vocal gaps (from the STAR survey top-5, 2026-10-26).

candidates.name: differentiable_parameter_fitting
candidates.summary: Fit technique parameter defaults from example mixes and freeze them as deterministic defaults — the DJTransGAN method, not its torch stack (from the STAR survey top-5, 2026-10-26).

candidates.name: set_order_layer
candidates.summary: Longest-path set ordering under Camelot-key and energy-flow constraints, run before transition selection (from the STAR survey top-5, 2026-10-26).

candidates.name: selector_output_schema
candidates.summary: Richer selector output: duration_beats, quantize level, curve, fallback duration, reason string, transition-type class, vocal-clash risk, conflict-only EQ plan (from the STAR survey top-5, 2026-10-26). Learn-from only.
candidates.license_note: license unconfirmed — learn-from only, no code reuse

candidates.name: prose_recipe_as_structured_record
candidates.summary: Cookbook prose files parsed into TransitionRecipe structs with machine gating fields (requires_stems, max_bpm_delta, camelot_compatible_only); transfers as registry entries that carry executable gates, not just prose.

candidates.name: sub_bass_crossover_swap
candidates.summary: 4th-order Linkwitz-Riley split at 120 Hz where exactly one track's low band is present at any sample while mids/highs blend; transfers as the render primitive for the whole bass-swap family.

candidates.name: checklisted_technique_fit
candidates.summary: Each technique expressed as boolean checks returning fit plus per-check reasons measured from a real studied set; transfers as explainable per-technique fit reports (why this move fits / does not).

candidates.name: bpm_classification_half_time
candidates.summary: BPM gaps classified seamless (<=3%), ramp (<=6%), half_time (half/double fold within 6%), else cut_required; transfers as a tempo-gap classifier feeding technique eligibility.

candidates.name: weighted_roulette_selector
candidates.summary: Per-style scores sampled by roulette, not argmaxed, with score floors, a 0.4x repeat-style penalty and a 1.5x style-hint boost; transfers as a selector that preserves variety across a set instead of always picking the top score.
candidates.license_note: license unconfirmed - learn-from only, no code reuse

candidates.name: fit_downgrade_ladder
candidates.summary: Each style fit to available seconds before selection: phrase quantize downgrades to bar, then to a 4-beat minimum, then a 0.05x score multiplier; transfers as a feasibility step so long blends degrade gracefully instead of collapsing into cuts.
candidates.license_note: license unconfirmed - learn-from only, no code reuse

candidates.name: hold_blend_curve
candidates.summary: Crossfade curve ramping to a -3 dB centre, holding both decks audible through the middle, then completing; transfers as a curve family with a centre-hold parameter, distinct from linear/smoothstep fades.
candidates.license_note: license unconfirmed - learn-from only, no code reuse

candidates.name: bass_swap_move_script
candidates.summary: A chosen style compiles to a timed automation script of EQ/filter/gain moves in beats (incoming bass killed, tucked -14 dB pre-swap, swap window, highs opened/ducked); transfers as techniques that output executable move lists, not just names.
candidates.license_note: license unconfirmed - learn-from only, no code reuse

candidates.name: vocal_clash_ducking
candidates.summary: Lyric vocal windows for both tracks mapped onto wall-clock overlap via tempo anchors, with overlapping windows triggering a -9 dB mid-EQ duck on the outgoing deck starting 1 beat early; transfers as a vocal guard that ducks rather than blocks a blend.
candidates.license_note: license unconfirmed - learn-from only, no code reuse

candidates.name: spectral_band_swap
candidates.summary: 3-band EQ swap where the low band is always deep-cut on the incoming track (-26 dB) and restored over the fade, and mid/high cuts scale by per-band spectral clash; transfers as a parameterized registry technique with band corners, cut depths and swap timing.

candidates.name: symmetric_geometric_beatmatch
candidates.summary: Both decks meet at the geometric-mean tempo, each bending half the octave-folded BPM difference, with no stretch outside a +/-6% tolerance; transfers as a beatmatch mode with a tolerance parameter and a no-stretch fallback.

candidates.name: vocal_free_window_clamped_fade
candidates.summary: Fade length hard-capped to min(outgoing vocal-free outro, incoming vocal-free intro) from a full-track vocal timeline, so a fade never covers vocals on either side; transfers as a duration clamp driven by per-track vocal windows.

candidates.name: camelot_transition_quality_table
candidates.summary: Every key pair maps to a 0.0-1.0 quality and type (same key 1.0, +/-1 same letter 0.95, same-hour letter swap 0.9, energy boosts 0.6/0.5, else 0.0 violation); transfers as the selector's harmonic scoring table.

candidates.name: chord_domino_pair_match
candidates.summary: Next song eligible only if its first chord exactly equals the previous song's last chord, chosen among matches without repeating a song; transfers as a hard pair-eligibility rule on boundary chords.

candidates.name: note_anchored_crossfade
candidates.summary: Fade-out starts exactly at the outgoing song's last-note time and fade-in ends exactly at the incoming song's first-note time, overlap capped at 5 s; transfers as anchoring fades to detected musical events rather than fixed offsets.

candidates.name: brute_force_alignment_search
candidates.summary: Every combination of outgoing boundary x incoming boundary x bar-overlap is rendered and graded and the best-scoring alignment wins; transfers as a selector that searches cue-point pairs rather than scoring one fixed exit/entry point.

candidates.name: fade_shape_vocabulary
candidates.summary: Five named fade shapes (linear, exponential, logarithmic, quarter-sine, half-sine) x fade-in/fade-out; transfers directly as the curve-shape parameter of every technique in the registry.

candidates.name: downbeat_anchored_cue_window
candidates.summary: Transition window starts 8 bars before the cue, snapped to the nearest detected downbeat; transfers as a placement rule: never start a transition mid-bar, always on a downbeat N bars early.

candidates.name: chorus_anchored_transition
candidates.summary: Per-measure chorus/non-chorus labels aligned to the beat grid; transfers as a placement gate: start/end transitions at chorus boundaries and never cut across a chorus.

candidates.name: silence_skip_transition
candidates.summary: AutoDJ modes that skip silent intros/outros, backed by a dedicated silence analyzer; transfers as a selector rule: when either side has leading/trailing silence, skip it instead of fading through dead air.
candidates.license_note: GPL-2.0-or-later - learn-from only, never copy code

candidates.summary: Curve-selected equal-power crossfade via afade/acrossfade (libavfilter/af_afade.c): per-stream fade curve selection (tri, qsin, esin, hsin, log, ...) for the acrossfade. Chained-multi-input and band-split variants NOT queued (unverified in official docs).

candidates.name: tidal_clutch_transition
